title: Health And Safety Manager
location: Basra, Al-Basra Governorate, Iraq
description: We are seeking an experienced Health & Safety professional, at Senior Officer or Manager level, to lead occupational health and safety at our terminal operations in Basra, Iraq. This is a hands-on, field-based role for someone comfortable operating in a challenging and complex operating environment, while maintaining close and structured coordination with head office and international financial institutions including the IFC. This role sits within a terminal operation financed in line with international standards, and the successful candidate will be expected to embed IFC Performance Standards (particularly PS2 on Labor and Working Conditions) into day-to-day site practice. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the terminal's Health & Safety program, ensuring safe execution of all stevedoring activities, cargo handling, lifting, other terminal activities and full compliance with local Iraqi regulations, international maritime/port safety standards, and IFC Performance Standards. Maintain and continuously improve site-level H&S management systems (risk assessments, incident investigation, permit-to-work, emergency response planning, contractor management). Conduct regular field inspections and audits across terminal operations and contractors, identifying hazards and driving corrective action to closure. Build and maintain a strong safety culture among terminal staff, contractors, and third-party operators on site. Prepare clear, high-quality written reports (in English) for head office, shareholders, and IFC/lender reporting requirements — including incident reports, monthly H&S performance data, and periodic compliance updates. Liaise directly with IFC and/or other lenders during site visits, audits, or supervision missions, representing the terminal's H&S performance and improvement plans. Support implementation and continual improvement of the Occupational Health and Safety management system (ISO 45001) and the company health and safety procedures. Support emergency preparedness and response planning specific to the operating context in Basra. Manage relationships with local authorities, regulators, and emergency services as required. Mentor and build capability within the local H&S team over time. Candidate Profile Required: Significant professional experience (with a minimum of 6 years) in occupational health & safety management, ideally within ports, terminals, logistics, heavy industry, oil & gas, or infrastructure sectors. Working knowledge of IFC Performance Standards (particularly PS1 and PS2) and/or Equator Principles-aligned environments. Demonstrated ability to work independently in a demanding field environment while maintaining rigorous reporting discipline back to head office. Excellent written and spoken English — reporting quality and clarity are essential given the audience (shareholders, IFC, lenders). Willingness and ability to relocate to and reside in Umm Qasr, Iraq for a minimum of 2 years. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the composure to engage confidently with senior head office management and external financial institutions. Advantageous: Arabic language skills (spoken). Prior experience working in Iraq or comparable higher-risk/complex operating environments (Middle East, Africa, conflict-affected or post-conflict settings). Recognized H&S qualification (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent). Experience supporting IFC/DFI site supervision missions or audits.

title: Construction & Camp Supervisor
company: ILF Consulting Engineers in United Arab Emirates
location: Basra, Al-Basra Governorate, Iraq
description: Join Us as Construction & Camp Supervisor We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Construction & Camp Supervisor to join one of our strategic pipeline projects in Basra, Iraq. The role is responsible for overseeing project camps, accommodation facilities, site offices, welfare services, and operational support activities while coordinating with the Client, Contractors, and Service Providers to ensure compliance with project requirements, HSE standards, and contractual obligations. The position will act as the focal point for the day-to-day management of camp operations, facilities maintenance, personnel welfare, site logistics support, office infrastructure, and accommodation arrangements for project personnel mobilized to various project locations. Key Responsibilities Supervise the day-to-day operation and administration of project camps, accommodation facilities, site offices, and common welfare areas. Coordinate construction support and facility interfaces involving temporary works, accommodation units, offices, utilities, access, laydown or common areas, and related site services. Coordinate with the Client, contractors, and service providers regarding accommodation, office space, utilities, internet, transportation, catering, housekeeping, laundry, cleaning, waste management, and other agreed support services. Monitor contractors and service providers against project requirements and contractual obligations; verify service quality and follow up deficiencies, complaints, and corrective actions to closure. Manage room allocation, occupancy records, check-in and check-out arrangements, accommodation capacity, and forward planning for mobilizing and demobilizing personnel. Support personnel mobilization and demobilization, including accommodation, transportation, site access coordination, onboarding support, and liaison with HR, HSE, Logistics, and Administration. Conduct routine inspections of accommodation units, kitchens, dining areas, offices, welfare facilities, utilities, fire and life-safety systems, recreational areas, and general camp conditions. Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of camp infrastructure, buildings, equipment, utilities, furniture, and office facilities to maintain safe and reliable operations. Support office and temporary-facility setup, including furniture, equipment, IT and connectivity requirements, utilities, and readiness for project use. Ensure activities comply with approved plans, project procedures, HSE requirements, camp rules, welfare standards, emergency arrangements, evacuation plans, and client expectations. Monitor site and camp readiness, operational risks, delays, resource constraints, and safety or welfare concerns; report and escalate matters promptly to the responsible project function. Maintain accurate records of occupancy, inspections, incidents, maintenance requests, complaints, inventory, service performance, and corrective actions. Prepare weekly and monthly status reports covering camp operations, accommodation capacity, facility readiness, contractor performance, outstanding actions, and operational support matters. Support client, project, and HSE audits and inspections and ensure that requested evidence and corrective-action records are properly maintained. Liaise with Project Management, Construction, HR, HSE, Logistics, Administration, contractors, subcontractors, service providers, and relevant client representatives. Qualifications & Experience Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Facilities Management or a related field. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in camp management, facilities management, construction site administration, accommodation operations, workforce welfare, or project support services on major oil and gas, pipeline, infrastructure, PMC, EPC, or construction projects. Practical experience coordinating contractors, service providers, maintenance activities, site logistics, workforce accommodation, offices, and welfare services. Previous experience in Iraq, the GCC, or remote construction camps is highly preferred. Experience supporting large, multicultural project workforces is an advantage. Additional HSE, fire safety, first aid, facilities management, or related certifications are advantageous. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Arabic language capability is an advantage. Skills & Competencies Strong camp, facilities, site-support, and contractor-management capabilities. Good understanding of accommodation operations, welfare services, basic construction interfaces, facilities maintenance, utilities, and site logistics. Working knowledge of HSE inspections, incident reporting, emergency response, fire and life safety, and camp welfare requirements. Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, resolve operational issues, and follow actions through to completion. Strong communication, problem-solving, conflict-resolution, planning, reporting, and record-keeping skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and able to maintain clear trackers, inspection records, and status reports. Rotation & Work Schedule Location: Basra, Iraq Rotation Pattern: Flexible rotational assignment based on project requirements Rotational travel, accommodation, transportation, and site logistics will be provided in accordance with company policies. Interested candidates who are currently based in Iraq or willing to relocate to Basra are encouraged to apply.

title: Snr Integrity and RBI Engineer
location: Basra, Al-Basra Governorate, Iraq
description: Geo-Jade Petroleum – South Basra Integrated Project (SBIPRO) is seeking an experienced Snr Integrity and RBI Engineer with 12–15 years solid Oil & Gas experience . This role works with Production Department on rotation basis based in Basra Iraq. The Senior Integrity & RBI Engineer is responsible for leading the Asset Integrity Management System (AIMS) and Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) programs to ensure safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of production facilities, pipelines, static equipment, and associated infrastructure. The role develops integrity strategies, conducts risk assessments, defines inspection intervals, and ensures systematic identification and mitigation of integrity threats to minimize failures, environmental incidents, and production losses. Provides technical leadership in integrity engineering, fitness-for-service (FFS) assessments, degradation management, and lifecycle planning in compliance with Company standards and international best practices. Ensures full compliance with Company Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies to maximize Loss Prevention and regulatory compliance. Contributes to preparation and monitoring of integrity-related budgets. Mentors junior integrity and inspection engineers and supports competency development Key deliverables RBI studies and updated risk registers Integrity Operating Window (IOW) documentation Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessment reports Annual integrity management plan Equipment risk ranking and mitigation strategies Life extension evaluation reports Integrity KPI and compliance reports Asset risk dashboards for management Health, Security, Safety and Environment Ensures integrity programs prioritize prevention of loss of containment and major accident hazards. Participates in HAZOP, risk assessments, and safety reviews related to asset integrity. Escalates high-risk integrity threats that could impact personnel safety or environment. Promotes strong safety culture within inspection, corrosion, and integrity teams. Ensures compliance with regulatory requirements related to pressure systems and pipelines.
